skills.name: bsc-pool-depth
skills.description: Measure what a trade on BNB Smart Chain actually costs before placing it — real pool depth, price impact per trade size, and the transfer tax read off executed trades rather than off a label. Works on any BEP-20 token or pool address. Use when asked whether a token is liquid enough to trade, what slippage to expect, how big a position a pool can absorb, or why a swap quote looks worse than the headline price.
